    {
      "id": "CR002-011",
      "page": 21,
      "ar": "كالنصفية والثلثية والربعية الثابتة والمندرجة في هذا الواحد المشهود ههنا ، التي ينتشىء منها الأعداد في المراتب الوجودية",
      "en": "Like halfness, thirdness and quarterness, established and contained in the one considered here, from which numbers arise in existential ranks.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Numerical analogy illustrates included relations, not arithmetic divisions within the Essence.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/21?lang=ar",
      "grade": "printed-digital-Arabic-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR002-012",
      "page": 21,
      "ar": "وينتشىء من تلك الاعتبارات أعيان الاثنين والثلاثة والأربعة فيها ، كما يقال : الواحد نصف الاثنين ، وثلث الثلاثة ، وربع الأربعة وهلمّ جرّا",
      "en": "And from these considerations arise the distinct two, three and four: the one is half of two, a third of three, a quarter of four, and so on.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Keep ʿayn as determinate identity here, not the same sense as externally existing individual.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/21?lang=ar",
      "grade": "printed-digital-Arabic-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR002-013",
      "page": 21,
      "ar": "والذات بهذا الاعتبار يسمّى واحدا اسما ثبوتيّا لا سلبيّا ، ولم تصح إضافة هذه الاعتبارات المذكورة إلى الاسم الأحد لا حقيقة ولا وضعا لغويّا",
      "en": "Under this consideration the Essence is called wāḥid, an affirmative rather than a negative name. These considerations are not properly attributed to the name aḥad, either in reality or by linguistic convention.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "The last phrase continues in the next printed page with 'فحقائق هذه الاعتبارات'.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/21?lang=ar",
      "grade": "printed-digital-Arabic-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR002-014",
      "page": 22,
      "ar": "الاعتبارات في أول رتبة الذات ثابتة للاسم الواحد الحقيقي ، ومندرجة فيه ثبوتا حقيقيّا واندراجا أصليّا",
      "en": "These considerations at the first rank of the Essence are established for the truly One and included within it by real establishment and original inclusion.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Source presents true thubūt but does not equate it with external existential actuality.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/22?lang=ar",
      "grade": "printed-digital-Arabic-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR002-015",
      "page": 22,
      "ar": "كما أن أمثلتها وصورها ثابتة لهذا الواحد المشهود أثره لنا ههنا ، ومندرجة فيه غير قادحة في الرتبتين في صرافة هذا الواحد ، ولا منافية لها",
      "en": "As their analogues and forms are established within the one whose effect is witnessed here, their inclusion at either rank neither impairs nor contradicts the simplicity of that one.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "The clause explicitly controls the number analogy's ontological limits.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/22?lang=ar",
      "grade": "printed-digital-Arabic-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR002-016",
      "page": 22,
      "ar": "ومتعلق هذا الاعتبار الواحدي ظهور الذات ووجودها وأبديّتها ؛ كما أن متعلق الاعتبار الأحدي بطونها وأزليّتها",
      "en": "The consideration of oneness concerns the Essence's manifestation, existence and perpetuity; the consideration of unicity concerns its hiddenness and pre-eternity.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Preserve the parallel between ẓuhūr / buṭūn and abad / azal.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/22?lang=ar",
      "grade": "printed-digital-Arabic-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR002-017",
      "page": 22,
      "ar": "ولا مغايرة ولا غيرية بين هذين الاعتبارين ، ولا بين كل اعتبار واعتبار من اعتبارات الواحدية في أول رتبة الذات الآتي بيانه",
      "en": "There is neither differentiation nor otherness between these two considerations, nor between one consideration of oneness and another at the first rank of the Essence.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Distinguish mughāyara and ghayriyya as both negated, not just simple sameness.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/22?lang=ar",
      "grade": "printed-digital-Arabic-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR002-018",
      "page": 22,
      "ar": "لأن المغايرة والغيرية من أحكام الكثرة والمنافاة الثابتة بينها وبين الوحدة ، ولا كثرة ثمة تنافي الوحدة ، بل تلك الوحدة هي المنشئة لكل وحدة وكثرة مفهومة ههنا متغايرة عندنا",
      "en": "For difference and otherness are judgments of multiplicity and its opposition to unity. There, no multiplicity exists that opposes unity; that unity is the source of every unity and multiplicity understood here as different.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "This does not by itself negate real plurality in subsequent manifested ranks.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/22?lang=ar",
      "grade": "printed-digital-Arabic-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR002-019",
      "page": 22,
      "ar": "ولا يفهم ارتفاع هذه المغايرة في تلك الحضرة إلّا من ارتفع حالا ومقاما عن التقيّد بالمراتب المقيّدة بأحكام الكثرة والمقيّدة لأربابها بها",
      "en": "None understands the removal of such difference in that Presence unless he has risen, in state and station, beyond restriction by ranks determined by judgments of multiplicity and restricting their occupants through them.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Explicit link between ontological rank and transformed apprehension.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/22?lang=ar",
      "grade": "printed-digital-Arabic-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR002-020",
      "page": 22,
      "ar": "ولارتفاع حكم هذه المغايرة في الرتبة الأولى حكم بها بعض أكابر المحقّقين من أهل اللّه بأن الواحد الأحد اسم واحد مركّب ؛ كبعلبك ومعديكرب",
      "en": "Because the judgment of difference is absent at the first rank, some eminent realized masters hold that al-wāḥid al-aḥad is one compound name, like Baʿlabakk or Maʿdīkarib.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Grammatical examples are genuine proper-name compounds; not a third ontological rank.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/22?lang=ar",
      "grade": "printed-digital-Arabic-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR002-021",
      "page": 22,
      "ar": "ثم اعلم أن هذه الاعتبارات الثابتة للواحد ثمة ، والمندرجة فيه في أول رتبة الذات المحكوم عليها فيها بأنها عين الذات",
      "en": "Know, further, that these considerations established for the One and included within it at the first rank of the Essence are judged there to be the Essence itself.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Differentiation at later ranks must not be inserted into this first-rank claim.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/22?lang=ar",
      "grade": "printed-digital-Arabic-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR002-022",
      "page": 22,
      "ar": "بحيث إن كل ما يضاف إلى الذات يضاف إلى كلّ واحد منها من الجمعية والاشتمال على الكلّ في هذه الرتبة الأولى بحسبها",
      "en": "Thus what is attributed to the Essence under the aspect of comprehensiveness and containing the whole is likewise attributed to each of the considerations at this rank.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "The qualifier 'at this rank' is essential.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/22?lang=ar",
      "grade": "printed-digital-Arabic-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR002-023",
      "page": 22,
      "ar": "نظرا من حيث مظاهرها وصورها وآثارها إليها ألفينا بعضها كلّيات وأصولا أول بمثابة أجناس عالية",
      "en": "If considered through their manifestations, forms and effects, some prove to be universals and primary principles comparable to supreme genera.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Move from first-rank inclusion to what follows upon later manifestation.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/22?lang=ar",
      "grade": "printed-digital-Arabic-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR002-024",
      "page": 22,
      "ar": "هي مسمّى ألفاظ دالّة على حقائق أسماء الذات ومفهوماتها التي منها مفاتح الغيب ، والواحد الأحد وباطن اسم اللّه ، وباطن اسم الرحمن الرحيم ، ومفهوم جمع أسماء الضمائر",
      "en": "These are the realities named by words designating the essential names and their concepts: the Keys of the Unseen, the One-in-Unicity, the inward aspect of Allāh, the inward aspect of al-Raḥmān and al-Raḥīm, and the comprehensive meaning of pronominal names.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Distinguish name-realities from their linguistic words, elaborated at later source pages.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/22?lang=ar",
      "grade": "printed-digital-Arabic-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR002-025",
      "page": 22,
      "ar": "ووجدنا بعض تلك الاعتبارات المندرجة في الواحدية من حيث النظر في مظاهرها وآثارها بمثابة أجناس تالية وأنواع مندرجة فيها وهلمّ جرّا إلى أشخاص هاوية إلى الدّركات الجزئية جدّا",
      "en": "Some of the considerations included within oneness, considered through their effects, are like lower genera, species included within them, and so on down to individuals at the most narrowly particular levels.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Avoid treating genera and species here as independent eternally existing substances.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/22?lang=ar",
      "grade": "printed-digital-Arabic-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR002-026",
      "page": 22,
      "ar": "التي بها يحكم على الحضرة الأبدية بعدم التناهي كثرة وتعيّنات وتقيّدات ، والكل ثابتة بصورها المعنوية في الرتبة الثانية بعضها بطريق التشخّص ، وبعضها بطريق الاندراج في الأصناف والأنواع",
      "en": "These yield the judgment that the perpetual Presence contains endlessly many determinations and restrictions. All are established as intelligible forms at the second rank, some individually, others by inclusion within kinds and species.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Explicit second-rank establishment versus first-rank inclusion.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/22?lang=ar",
      "grade": "printed-digital-Arabic-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR002-027",
      "page": 22,
      "ar": "نعم ، وقد تعيّنت وانضبطت جملة منها في اللّوح المحفوظ ، وتصوّرت صورا وجودية روحانية فيه منتهيا ظهورها بانتهاء يوم القيامة مجملا ومفصّلا",
      "en": "A group of these is also determined and fixed in the Preserved Tablet, acquiring spiritual existential forms whose display extends to the Resurrection, both comprehensively and in detail.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Not a blanket claim that all eternal knowables manifest in this way.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/22?lang=ar",
      "grade": "printed-digital-Arabic-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR002-028",
      "page": 22,
      "ar": "ويتفصّل منه في المراتب الوجودية مجملا في العرش ومفصّلا في الكرسي دفعة واحدة ، ثم يتفصّل منهما في الأركان والسماوات على التعاقب إلى أنهى مراتب",
      "en": "From the Tablet it is unfolded within existential ranks, comprehensively in the Throne and in detail in the Footstool in one act, and thereafter successively in the elements and heavens down to the lowest ranks—",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "The sentence runs across the p22–23 boundary; do not count any stage of manifestation as independent divinity.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/22?lang=ar",
      "grade": "printed-digital-Arabic-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR002-029",
      "page": 23,
      "ar": "الكون مثالا وحسّا ، وفي المواطن دنيا وبرزخا وآخرة ، وينتهي إلى ههنا جميع الشهودات والإدراكات والمكاشفات الحاصلة للكمّل والأولياء",
      "en": "—of the cosmos, in imaginal and sensory form and in its worldly, intermediate and hereafter abodes. All witnessing, apprehension and unveiling attained by perfected people and saints end at this limit.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Continues p22 sentence; note distinct metaphysical modes and abodes.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/23?lang=ar",
      "grade": "printed-digital-Arabic-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR002-030",
      "page": 23,
      "ar": "فالأدنى منهم وما فيهم أدنى ، والأعلى في حكم هذا الانتهاء سواء",
      "en": "The lowest among them and the highest are alike with respect to this limit.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "The sentence denies no distinction in actual spiritual rank; only the epistemic horizon.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/23?lang=ar",
      "grade": "printed-digital-Arabic-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR002-031",
      "page": 23,
      "ar": "إلّا أنه ربما يكون في الحضرة الغيبية الأزليّة نحو هذه الكلّيات والجزئيّات أمور باطنة وأحوال مستورة لم تتعيّن بعد لا في الرتبة الثانية ولا في اللّوح المحفوظ",
      "en": "Yet in the eternal unseen Presence there may perhaps be, regarding these universals and particulars, hidden things and concealed states not yet determined either at the second rank or in the Preserved Tablet.",
      "disposition": "corrected",
      "critical_note": "PHOTOGRAPHIC PRINT-TO-PRINT DIFFERENCE I1876 printed p8/scan12: سوى أنه ربما يكون; B2007 printed p23: إلّا أنه ربما يكون. Prefer I1876 connective provisionally; the modal ربما and the uncertain status of undetermined affairs must remain. Medieval witnesses not yet collated.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/23?lang=ar",
      "grade": "printed-digital-Arabic-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": true,
      "manuscript_verified": false,
      "historical_print": {
        "siglum": "I1876",
        "printed_page": 8,
        "scan_index": 12,
        "reading": "سوى أنه ربما يكون",
        "status": "historical-print-difference",
        "source_pdf": "https://mc.dlib.nyu.edu/files/books/princeton_aco000264/princeton_aco000264_lo.pdf",
        "hires": true,
        "photo_url": "https://github.com/gnamma-research/booksite/blob/master/texts/al-farghani/muntaha-al-madarik/facsimile-I1876-hires/images/scan_0012.jpg",
        "note": "Original-resolution historical I1876 p8 has سوى أنه, while B2007 p23 reads إلا أنه. Both are exceptive; adopt earlier print provisionally, with the Beirut reading preserved, without changing the modal nuance of ربما. No manuscript compared."
      },
      "edited_ar": "سوى أنه ربما يكون في الحضرة الغيبية الأزليّة نحو هذه الكلّيات والجزئيّات أمور باطنة وأحوال مستورة لم تتعيّن بعد لا في الرتبة الثانية ولا في اللّوح المحفوظ"
    },
    {
      "id": "CR002-032",
      "page": 23,
      "ar": "فلم تعلم ولم يحكم بشيء منها إلّا بعد تعيّنها ووقوعها في المراتب الوجودية بالتدريج مع الآنات",
      "en": "Accordingly they are not known or judged until their determination and occurrence in existential ranks, progressively with successive instants.",
      "disposition": "crux",
      "critical_note": "Historical print agreement now established at I1876 pp8–9 (scans12–13): the source really has فلم تعلم ولم يحكم بشيء منها إلا بعد تعينها. Preserve the claim exactly; it remains a difficult question about determinacy and knowledge, not evidence for an invented manuscript emendation.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/23?lang=ar",
      "grade": "printed-digital-Arabic-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": true,
      "manuscript_verified": false,
      "historical_print": {
        "siglum": "I1876",
        "printed_page": "8–9",
        "scan_index": "12–13",
        "reading": "فلم تعلم ولم يحكم بشيء منها إلا بعد تعينها",
        "status": "agreement",
        "source_pdf": "https://mc.dlib.nyu.edu/files/books/princeton_aco000264/princeton_aco000264_lo.pdf",
        "note": "Historic 1876 printing p8 end and p9 beginning preserve the difficult expression. This is a bounded print agreement; theological interpretation and manuscript text remain unresolved."
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "CR002-033",
      "page": 23,
      "ar": "وهي أبطن بطون أحكام الغيب الذاتي المغلوب والمسبوق بالرحمة الذاتية",
      "en": "These belong to the utmost inward depth of the judgments of the essential Unseen, which is preceded and overcome by essential mercy.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Distinguish hiddenness of rank from an event changing the Essence.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/23?lang=ar",
      "grade": "printed-digital-Arabic-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR002-034",
      "page": 23,
      "ar": "فلهذا أوجبت الرهبة والخشية المشار إليها في قوله تعالى : قُلْ ما كُنْتُ بِدْعاً مِنَ الرُّسُلِ وَما أَدْرِي ما يُفْعَلُ بِي وَلا بِكُمْ",
      "en": "They therefore occasion awe and fear, as indicated by 'Say: I am no novelty among messengers, and I do not know what will be done with me or with you' (Qurʾān 46:9).",
      "disposition": "annotate",
      "critical_note": "Farghānī's interpretation of the verse is an exegetical move; the verse alone does not prove his exact metaphysical thesis.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/23?lang=ar",
      "grade": "printed-digital-Arabic-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR002-035",
      "page": 23,
      "ar": "ومن وجه أيضا يشير إليها قوله صلّى اللّه عليه وسلّم شفقا منها : « ليت ربّ محمد لم يخلق محمدا »",
      "en": "And from another aspect the saying attributed to the Prophet, expressing concern, 'Would that Muḥammad's Lord had not created Muḥammad', is taken as an allusion to them.",
      "disposition": "annotate",
      "critical_note": "The Beirut editor explicitly reports no source found for this statement. Do not attribute it as authenticated hadith.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/23?lang=ar",
      "grade": "printed-digital-Arabic-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR002-036",
      "page": 23,
      "ar": "مع أنه كان من حيث ما تعيّن من حاله صلّى اللّه عليه وسلّم في الحضرة العلمية واللّوح المحفوظ على بصيرة من ربّه",

    },
    {
      "id": "CR002-037",

      "en": "Thus in reliance on it he could say, 'Adam and those below him are under my banner on the Day of Resurrection, without boasting', and 'Were Moses alive, he would have no option but to follow me'.",

    {

    },
    {

      "page": 23,

    },
    {
      "id": "CR002-041",
      "page": 23,
      "ar": "ثم إنه قد عبّر بعض العلماء باللّه الواقفين على حضراته الكلية عن بعض اعتبارات الواحدية المندرجة فيها في الرتبة الأولى بالشؤون الذاتية",

    {

      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/26?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-span-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR003-023",
      "page": 26,
      "ar": "والبصر هو قبول ظهوره بما هو ظاهر من القابل منه",
      "en": "Sight is receptivity to the meaning's appearing in whatever becomes manifest to its recipient.",
      "disposition": "revise",
      "critical_note": "The printed Arabic is syntactically dense. The object is the appearance of the meaning; further historical witnesses may refine referents.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/26?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-span-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR003-024",
      "page": 26,
      "ar": "والقوة تمكن مما يطلب ظهوره",
      "en": "Power is the capacity for the realization of what seeks to appear.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Quwwa is explicitly defined by the intended appearance, not bare mechanical force.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/26?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-span-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR003-025",
      "page": 26,
      "ar": "فلفظ وكلي بي لسان محدث",
      "en": "My utterance—and my whole being is a tongue speaking through me.",
      "disposition": "crux",
      "critical_note": "First Ibn al-Fāriḍ hemistich in Beirut. Collateral poetic reading: B2007 p26 gives ولحظ ... عين لعبرة, whereas a separate published Tāʾiyya in the Qayṣarī commentary (verse 545) and Wikisource read لعبرتي. These are parallel poem texts, NOT independent Farghānī manuscript witnesses.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/26?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-span-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR003-026",
      "page": 26,
      "ar": "معاني صفات ما ورى اللّبس أثبتت",
      "en": "The meanings of the attributes were established beyond their clothing in multiplicity.",
      "disposition": "revise",
      "critical_note": "Lubs ('putting on' or 'clothing') is the metaphor for differentiation of what is not yet distinct at the first rank; previous 'beyond the clothing of appearance' under-specified this.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/26?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-span-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR003-027",
      "page": 26,
      "ar": "صفات متغايرة في الرتبة الثانية بحسبها وحكمها",
      "en": "attributes distinct from one another at the second rank according to that rank's law.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Explicit differentiation occurs at second rank; avoid transferring independent multiplicity to the Essence at first rank.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/26?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-span-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR003-028",
      "page": 26,
      "ar": "بعد أن لم تكن في تلك الرتبة الأولى صفات ، بل اعتبارات غير متميّزة ولا متغايرة فيها",
      "en": "though at that first rank they were not attributes but considerations neither distinct nor mutually divergent.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Critical distinction: shūʾūn/considerations at first rank vs distinct attributes at second rank.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/26?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-span-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR003-029",
      "page": 26,
      "ar": "وباطنها الأول : أن تكون هذه الصفات مضافة إلى نفسه",
      "en": "The first inward level is the attribution of these qualities to the individual's soul.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "The 'first inward' degree follows their outward manifestation in bodily faculties, and so is not the initial divine self-disclosure.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/26?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-span-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR003-030",
      "page": 26,
      "ar": "بظاهر العقل المعيشي المقيّد بأمور دنيوية",
      "en": "by the outward appearance of practical intellect restricted to worldly concerns.",
      "disposition": "revise",
      "critical_note": "ʿAql maʿīshī is livelihood-oriented intellect; 'practical intellect' here is contextual and must not be mistaken for the whole Aristotelian practical intellect.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/26?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-span-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR003-031",
      "page": 27,
      "ar": "وباطنها الثاني : ما يضاف إلى نفسه من حيث عقله المنوّر بنور الشرع والإيمان باللّه",
      "en": "The second inward level pertains to the soul insofar as its intellect is illuminated by revealed law and faith in God.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Law and faith illuminate intellect, enabling reorientation from world to afterlife; do not collapse into generic philosophical insight.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/27?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-span-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR003-032",
      "page": 27,
      "ar": "وباطنها الثالث : ما يضاف منها إلى روحه الروحانية المجرّدة",
      "en": "The third inward level pertains to the individual's immaterial spiritual spirit.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Preserve the doubled expression rūḥuhu al-rūḥāniyya; it differentiates this level from ordinary psychical faculty.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/27?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-span-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR003-033",
      "page": 27,
      "ar": "الثابت تعيّنها وتميّزها في عالم الأرواح واللّوح المحفوظ",
      "en": "whose determination and distinctness are established in the world of spirits and the Preserved Tablet.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "That distinctness belongs to a cosmic level; no reason to infer independent divine existence.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/27?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-span-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR003-034",
      "page": 27,
      "ar": "وباطنها الرابع : ما يضاف منها إلى الوجود العيني المضاف إلى حقيقة الإنسانية",
      "en": "The fourth inward level concerns concrete existence as related to the reality of humanity.",
      "disposition": "revise",
      "critical_note": "ʿAynī is actual/concrete rather than 'eye-like'; at this level the same senses are interpreted as disclosures of existential reality.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/27?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-span-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR003-035",
      "page": 27,
      "ar": "المقيّد بها والمظهر لأحكامها في مراتب الكون روحا ومثالا وحسّا",
      "en": "delimited by it and manifesting its rulings in cosmic ranks as spirit, image, and sense.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "The three modalities remain distinguishable even when a single principle is at issue.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/27?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-span-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR003-036",
      "page": 27,
      "ar": "وباطنها الخامس : ما يضاف منها إلى قلبه القابل التجلّي الوجود الباطني فيه",
      "en": "The fifth inward level relates to the heart receptive to the disclosure of inward existence within it.",
      "disposition": "revise",
      "critical_note": "This is the heart's capacity of reception, not a claim of spatial containment of God.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/27?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-span-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR003-037",
      "page": 27,
      "ar": "وسعني قلب عبدي",
      "en": "The heart of My servant encompassed Me.",
      "disposition": "annotate",
      "critical_note": "Farghānī cites a well-known spiritual saying; its role in his argument does not authenticate it as a prophetic or divine ḥadīth.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/27?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-span-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR003-038",
      "page": 27,
      "ar": "وباطنها السادس : ما يضاف منها إلى الوجود المطلق الرحمني الجمعي",
      "en": "The sixth inward level relates to comprehensive, merciful, nondelimited existence.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "'Nondelimited' here belongs to the specific sixth-level perspective, not automatically identical with absolutely unconditioned Essence.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/27?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-span-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR003-039",
      "page": 27,
      "ar": "الظاهر في مرتبة البرزخية الثانية بحكم فياضيته التي عمّ كل شيء",
      "en": "appearing at the second intermediary rank through its effusiveness, which extends to all things.",
      "disposition": "revise",
      "critical_note": "Crucial distinction between first determination and second intermediary, against prematurely equating all references to barzakh.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/27?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-span-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR003-040",
      "page": 27,
      "ar": "وسابع أبطنها : هي هذه المعاني الكائنة في الرتبة الأولى متوحّدة العين متميّزة الحكم بالنسبة",
      "en": "Their seventh inward depth consists of the meanings at the first rank, one in reality and distinguished in ruling only relationally.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Unity of reality and relative distinction of ḥukm, not numerical identity of faculties at their empirical level.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/27?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-span-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR003-041",
      "page": 28,
      "ar": "ومنهم : من انفتح له باب ثالث وهو من خواصّهم",
      "en": "Some have the third gate opened: they are among the elect of the believers.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "The ascent concerns differential openings of inward capacities, not simply social class.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/28?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-span-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR003-042",
      "page": 28,
      "ar": "ومنهم : من انفتح له باب رابع ، وهو من أهل بداية مقام الولاية والإحسان",
      "en": "Some have the fourth opened: these are at the beginning of the station of sainthood and excellence (iḥsān).",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Keep iḥsān as technical spiritual term.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/28?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-span-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR003-043",
      "page": 28,
      "ar": "ومنهم : من انفتح له باب سادس ، وهو من أهل النهايات ، وهم الكمّل والأفراد",
      "en": "Others have the sixth opened: they are among those of the final stations, the perfected and the singular ones.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "al-Afrād is a technical Sufi category; do not paraphrase as merely 'individuals'.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/28?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-span-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR003-044",
      "page": 28,
      "ar": "ولا تنفتح خوخة من الباب السابع لأحد إلّا لصاحب الإرث المحمدي",
      "en": "Not even a small aperture of the seventh gate opens to anyone except one who bears the Muhammadan inheritance.",
      "disposition": "revise",
      "critical_note": "The aperture/inheritance distinction qualifies the following uniqueness statement; the English should not exclude inheritors absolutely.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/28?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-span-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR003-045",
      "page": 28,
      "ar": "فإن البطن السابع مختصّ به صلى اللّه عليه وسلم",
      "en": "for the seventh inward depth belongs particularly to him—God bless him and grant him peace.",
      "disposition": "annotate",
      "critical_note": "A Muhammadan inheritor's partial opening differs from the station's proper privilege; do not construe the sentences as a flat contradiction.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/28?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-span-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR003-046",
      "page": 28,
      "ar": "وذلك أصل الحياة والحيّ وباطنه",
      "en": "that is the origin and inward reality of life and the Living.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Farghānī derives attribute concepts as principial considerations; distinction from later attributes remains essential.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/28?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-span-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR003-047",
      "page": 28,
      "ar": "ومن حيث الملاحظة متضمّن إحساسا بسريان ذلك الكمال في تفاصيل اعتبارات الواحدية",
      "en": "insofar as it is contemplation, it includes awareness of that perfection's diffusion through the detailed considerations of oneness.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Here knowledge is indexed to wāḥidiyya and detailed considerations, not bare aḥadiyya.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/28?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-span-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR003-048",
      "page": 28,
      "ar": "ومن حيث ذلك الميل بالسماع والإصغاء تقتضي اعتبارا هو أصل الإرادة",
      "en": "insofar as it involves inclining in hearing and attentive listening, it entails a consideration underlying will.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Do not infer psychological appetite from the term 'inclination'.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/28?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-span-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR003-049",
      "page": 28,
      "ar": "وحكم تحقيق تفصيل الكمال ، وتحصيل شرائطه متضمّن حقيقة الجود بإفاضة الوجود على حقيقة كل موجود",
      "en": "The realization of perfection in detail, with its conditions, entails the reality of generosity through the bestowal of existence on the reality of each existent.",
      "disposition": "revise",
      "critical_note": "The 'generosity' / 'effusion of existence' linkage is explicit. This is not automatically Guénon's account of principial possibility.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/28?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-span-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR003-050",
      "page": 28,
      "ar": "ورعاية العدالة في القوابل بين الوجوب والاستحالة",
      "en": "and the preservation of due proportion among receptivities between necessity and impossibility.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Justice is the appropriate distribution of ranks according to modalities of receptivity.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/28?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-span-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR003-051",
      "page": 28,
      "ar": "من حيث تحقّقها في حاق البرزخية الثانية",
      "en": "insofar as these are realized at the very core of the second intermediacy.",
      "disposition": "crux",
      "critical_note": "Attachment of the plural feminine pronoun and transition from the first to second barzakh require punctuation and witness checking. Avoid merging the two levels.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/28?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-span-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR003-052",
      "page": 29,
      "ar": "وباطن كل حقيقة إلهية وكونيّة",
      "en": "the inward reality of every divine and cosmic reality.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Continuation of 'Reality of Realities' from p28; page break must not sever the syntax.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/29?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-span-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR003-053",
      "page": 29,
      "ar": "وهو سار بكليته فيه بحيث يكون في الإلهيّة إلهيّا ، وفي الكونية كونيّا",
      "en": "it permeates each in its entirety, such that it is divine in divine realities and cosmic in cosmic realities.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Do not translate pervasion as literal local diffusion or confusion of creator and creation.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/29?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-span-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR003-054",
      "page": 29,
      "ar": "وسمّاه بعضهم البرزخ الأكبر الجامع لجميع البرازخ وأصلها الساري فيها",
      "en": "Some call it the Supreme Intermediary, encompassing all intermediaries and being their pervasive principle.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Attribution is to 'some'; not an equation automatically accepted across all Akbarī authors.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/29?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-span-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR003-055",
      "page": 29,
      "ar": "وكنى عنه الشرع بمقام أو أدنى ، فإنه باطن مقام قاب قوسين",
      "en": "Revelation alludes to it through the station of 'or nearer,' the inward reality of 'the distance of two bows'.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Qurʾān 53:9 is interpreted through Farghānī's metaphysical hermeneutics; distinguish Qurʾānic wording from that interpretation.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/29?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-span-checked-v1",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR003-056",
      "page": 29,
      "ar": "أي قرب قوسي الوحدة والكثرة ، أو قل القابلية والفاعلية ، أو قل قوسي الوجوب والإمكان",
      "en": "that is, the two bows of unity and multiplicity, or receptivity and activity, or necessity and possibility.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Three alternative relational axes are illustrative of a comprehensive intermediary, not interchangeable logical predicates in every context.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/29?lang=ar",

    {

      "ar": "سمي المتوسّط مرتبة الإمكان",
      "en": "The intermediate category is called the rank of possibility.",

    {

    {

      "page": 35,

      "en": "Thus relational multiplicity of negative and affirmative names proceeds from it.",

      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/37?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-locus-checked",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR005-003",
      "page": 37,
      "ar": "فكان لذلك داخلا في القول ومنبعثا ومتفرّعا منه",
      "en": "Therefore [power] is included in speech, originates from it and branches from it.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "The antecedent is القدرة, not الجود. Keep the page-wide referential sequence explicit.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/37?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-locus-checked",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR005-004",
      "page": 37,
      "ar": "وانبعاث بعضها من بعض نزولا ، واندراج بعضها في بعض عودا ورجوعا",
      "en": "Their emergence one from another in descent and their mutual inclusion on return and re-ascent.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "The two directions are deliberately symmetrical; not merely a list of seven names.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/37?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-locus-checked",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR005-005",
      "page": 38,
      "ar": "( والقابل ) يجمعها من أن كل واحد منها من تعيّنات النفس الرحمني",
      "en": "The Receptive gathers them insofar as each is a determination of the Breath of the All-merciful.",
      "disposition": "annotate",
      "critical_note": "STAGE XV PHOTO UPDATE: I1876 printed p20 scan24 explicitly reads القابل, agreeing with the B2007 digitized Arabic on this disputed word. The earlier conjecture القائل is NOT witnessed in either printed source; retain القابل as the provisional edited lemma. Distinguish receptivity from the seven-name category القائل attested elsewhere. MSS uncollated.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/38?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-locus-checked",
      "historical_print_verified": true,
      "manuscript_verified": false,
      "historical_print": {
        "printed_page": 20,
        "scan_index": 24,
        "status": "historic-print-agreement",
        "reading": "والقابل يجمعها",
        "note": "The noun القابل is present in the photographed 1876 printed page, despite internal parallel mentions of القائل elsewhere. See I1876-L11; no manuscript evidence.",
        "source_pdf": "https://mc.dlib.nyu.edu/files/books/princeton_aco000264/princeton_aco000264_lo.pdf",
        "original_image_url": "https://sites.dlib.nyu.edu/viewer/api/image/books/princeton_aco000264/24/full/2200,/0/default.jpg",
        "original_viewer_url": "https://sites.dlib.nyu.edu/viewer/books/princeton_aco000264/1?embed=1&lang=en",
        "archived_scan_sha256": "3bdb65963d2ba22687ee50071b08e7b1983796ec50642da2d021b30169d26d00",
        "linked_collation": "editorial/I1876_COLLATION_CUMULATIVE_005.json"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "CR005-006",
      "page": 38,
      "ar": "( والقادر ) يشملها لصحة إضافة التمكّن من التأثير إلى كل واحد منها بأثر مختصّ به",
      "en": "The Powerful comprises them because a capacity to produce an effect special to each can be attributed to each.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Each name has an effect proper to its distinct reality.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/38?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-locus-checked",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR005-007",
      "page": 38,
      "ar": "أحدهما : اشتمال كل واحد منها على الباقي",
      "en": "First, each of them contains all the rest.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "The first consideration is inclusive unity with a latent trace of difference.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/38?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-locus-checked",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR005-008",
      "page": 38,
      "ar": "تحقّق تميّزها وظهور أثر تختصّ بكل واحد منها",
      "en": "Their differentiation becomes established and an effect proper to each appears.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "The inverse second consideration makes differentiation explicit but inclusion latent.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/38?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-locus-checked",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR005-009",
      "page": 39,
      "ar": "وحقائق الكمل الذين هم أولو العزم من الرّسل ثابتة ومندرجة فيها",
      "en": "The realities of the perfected messengers of firm resolve are fixed and included within it.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "These are intelligible prophetic realities; do not suggest historical prophets literally merged into a person.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/39?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-locus-checked",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR005-010",
      "page": 39,
      "ar": "انتشأت من هذه الحقائق السبعة الأصلية الإلهية اثنان وتسعون حقيقة إلهيّة",
      "en": "From these seven original divine realities emerge ninety-two divine realities.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Seven plus ninety-two supplies the schematic ninety-nine; source is an internal metaphysical enumeration.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/39?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-locus-checked",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR005-011",
      "page": 39,
      "ar": "تسع وتسعون حقيقة تعيّنت بها الأسماء التسعة والتسعون",
      "en": "Ninety-nine realities by which the ninety-nine names become determined.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Keep realities distinct from the verbal expressions that designate the names (cf. p44).",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/39?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-locus-checked",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR005-012",
      "page": 39,
      "ar": "وهذه كلها تفصيل الحقيقة الكلّية المحمديّة الشاملة كلها",
      "en": "All these are differentiations of the universal Muhammadan reality which comprehends them all.",
      "disposition": "annotate",
      "critical_note": "The universal's relation to particulars is the author's analogy; not physical distribution of a material substance.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/39?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-locus-checked",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR005-013",
      "page": 40,
      "ar": "فكل ما تنسب إليه الجمعية بينهما والمضاهاة لبرزخيّتهما ، ولو بنسبة ما كانت حقيقة إنسانية",
      "en": "Whatever has even some comprehensive likeness to the intermediacy between them constitutes a human reality.",
      "disposition": "revise",
      "critical_note": "Clarify that إنسانية denotes a metaphysical mode or reality, not merely belonging to the biological human species.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/40?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-locus-checked",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR005-014",
      "page": 40,
      "ar": "فكان ذلك الاسم ربّه ، فلا يأخذ إلّا منه ، ولا يعطي إلّا به",
      "en": "That name is its Lord: it receives only from it and gives only through it.",
      "disposition": "annotate",
      "critical_note": "Here ربّه is lordship under a determining divine name, not an autonomous deity or identity of a created individual with the Divine Essence.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/40?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-locus-checked",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR005-015",
      "page": 40,
      "ar": "وسمّيت أعيانا ثابتة لثبوتها في المرتبة الثانية لم تبرح منها",
      "en": "They are called fixed entities because they are established in the second rank and do not leave it.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "This says their fixity is in the second determination, not their physical subsistence as formed bodies.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/40?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-locus-checked",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR005-016",
      "page": 40,
      "ar": "ولم يظهر بالوجود العينيّ إلا لوازمها وأحكامها وعوارضها المتعلّقة بمراتب الكون",
      "en": "Only their concomitants, judgments and accidents connected to cosmic ranks appear in concrete existence.",
      "disposition": "revise",
      "critical_note": "Decisive distinction for fixed entities: do not say the fixed entities themselves migrate into concrete existence.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/40?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-locus-checked",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR005-017",
      "page": 41,
      "ar": "والكل أمور نسبية معدومة لأنفسها لا وجود لها إلّا في علم العالم بها",
      "en": "All are relational matters, nonexistent in themselves, existing only in the knowledge of the one who knows them.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Read with the p40 account of quiddities; the statement concerns these determinate relational realities.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/41?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-locus-checked",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR005-018",
      "page": 41,
      "ar": "كان في عماء ما فوقه هواء ، وما تحته هواء",
      "en": "He was in ʿamāʾ; the following phrase concerning air above and below remains syntactically disputed.",
      "disposition": "crux",
      "critical_note": "The Arabic phrase has competing interpretations: mā as negation (no air above/below) versus relative/interrogative or a variant without mā. Classical transmission itself varies. Do not silently impose one vocalization; see al-Tirmidhī 3109, Ibn Qutayba Taʾwīl mukhtalif al-ḥadīth, and critical hadith notes.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/41?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-locus-checked",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR005-019",
      "page": 41,
      "ar": "وهذا التجلّي الثاني الوجودي الظاهري العيني سار في هذه الحضرة العمائية",
      "en": "This second self-disclosure in outward, concrete existence pervades the Cloud-like Presence.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "The second existential manifestation is an outward disclosure; avoid treating ʿamāʾ as a merely meteorological cloud.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/41?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-locus-checked",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR005-020",
      "page": 42,
      "ar": "إنما هي حقائق معنوية",
      "en": "They are intelligible realities.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "The universal ranks are not literal spatial containers; the metaphor of loci of manifestation is qualified by معنوية.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/42?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-locus-checked",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR005-021",
      "page": 42,
      "ar": "قسم منسوب إلى الحق مختصّ به",
      "en": "A class ascribed exclusively to the Real.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "First of the three divisions of realities.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/42?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-locus-checked",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR005-022",
      "page": 42,
      "ar": "القسم الثاني : منسوب إلى الكون ؛ كالفقر والعدمية الذاتية والذلّة والإمكان",
      "en": "The second class belongs to the cosmos: poverty, intrinsic nonbeing, lowliness and possibility.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Keep فقر and إمكانية as distinct but related categories.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/42?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-locus-checked",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR005-023",
      "page": 42,
      "ar": "والقسم الثالث : ما ينسب إلى الحقّ بالأصالة ، وإلى الكون بتبعية إضافة الوجود إليه",
      "en": "The third is attributed primarily to the Real and secondarily to the cosmos by attribution of existence to it.",
      "disposition": "revise",
      "critical_note": "The same label (such as knowledge) can be predicated in differing modes; do not equate divine and creaturely possession.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/42?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-locus-checked",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR005-024",
      "page": 43,
      "ar": "فأمّا الكلّيات والمتبوعات ، فما برحت محصورة في مبدأ الحضرة العلمية والمرتبة الثانية",
      "en": "Universals and principal realities never depart from the source of the Presence of Knowledge, the second rank.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Principal intelligibles remain at their source; their concomitants manifest through spiritual, imaginal and sensible ranks.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/43?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-locus-checked",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR005-025",
      "page": 43,
      "ar": "وهذه المراتب الكلّية منحصرة في خمس مراتب : اثنتان منها منسوبتان إلى الحق ، وثلاث منسوبة إلى الكون ، وسادسها جامع بينها",
      "en": "The universal ranks number five—two attributed to the Real and three to the cosmos—and a sixth that unites them.",
      "disposition": "annotate",
      "critical_note": "The count is FIVE plus a SIXTH comprehensive rank; do not collapse this into five equally homogeneous ranks.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/43?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-locus-checked",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR005-026",
      "page": 43,
      "ar": "وظهورها للعالم بها ، لا لأنفسها وأمثالها",
      "en": "They are manifest to the Knower of them, but not to themselves or their likes.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Distinct second-rank intelligibility from creaturely self-manifestation in later worlds.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/43?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-locus-checked",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR005-027",
      "page": 44,
      "ar": "وإنما هذه الألفاظ هي أسماء تلك الأسماء والدلالات عليها",
      "en": "These expressions are names of those names and indications pointing to them.",
      "disposition": "revise",
      "critical_note": "Names as ontological determinations are distinct from mutable linguistic signs; retain 'names of names' rather than calling the words the divine realities themselves.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/44?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-locus-checked",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR005-028",
      "page": 44,
      "ar": "وكلمة « تنكري » بالتركية متغيّرة متبدّلة ومختلفة",
      "en": "The Turkish expression 'Tengrī' too changes and differs.",
      "disposition": "annotate",
      "critical_note": "The printed Arabic gives تنكري (a historical spelling of a Turkic divine designation). Retain the literal attested spelling and distinguish normalization from author's text.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/44?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-locus-checked",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR005-029",
      "page": 44,
      "ar": "أولها : أسماء الذات ، وثانيها : أسماء الصفات ، وثالثها : أسماء الأفعال",
      "en": "First are names of Essence; second, names of attributes; third, names of acts.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "These are three ontological degrees, distinguished in addition to the crosscutting negative/affirmative division.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/44?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-locus-checked",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR005-030",
      "page": 45,
      "ar": "فإن لم يتعدّ من ذلك التعيّن والاعتبار أثر إلى الغير في مرتبة من المراتب الكونية",
      "en": "If no effect of that determination and consideration passes to another at a cosmic rank.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "This is the defining condition for names of attributes when the determination is not itself identical to Essence.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/45?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-locus-checked",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR005-031",
      "page": 45,
      "ar": "وإن تعدّى أثر منه في مرتبة من مراتب الكون",
      "en": "But if an effect from it extends into one of the cosmic ranks.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Such names are names of acts, e.g., Creator, Originator, Fashioner.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/45?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-locus-checked",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR005-032",
      "page": 45,
      "ar": "وتجلّيه الصفاتي لم يحصل إلّا بالتجرّد عن جميع أحكام المراتب الكونية ومظاهرها",
      "en": "His attributive self-disclosure occurs only through divestment of all judgments and manifestations of cosmic ranks.",
      "disposition": "annotate",
      "critical_note": "Distinguish modes of spiritual disclosure, not changing Divine Essence.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/45?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-locus-checked",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR005-033",
      "page": 46,
      "ar": "فانحصرت أقسام الأسماء كلّها في ثمانية أبواب",
      "en": "All the classes of names are thereby confined to eight doors.",
      "disposition": "annotate",
      "critical_note": "The preceding divisions are nested and overlapping; do not treat the eight as a flat mutually exclusive alphabetical list.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/46?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-locus-checked",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR005-034",
      "page": 46,
      "ar": "نوع ليس له صورة ظاهرة لفظيّة تدلّنا عليه هي اسمه",
      "en": "One kind has no outward verbal form that would indicate it to us as its name.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Retain distinction between an ontological name and a verbally available name.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/46?lang=ar",
      "grade": "modern-printed-digital-selected-locus-checked",
      "historical_print_verified": false,
      "manuscript_verified": false
    },
    {
      "id": "CR005-035",
      "page": 46,
      "ar": "أحدهما : مضمرات كلفظ هو وأنا ونحن",
      "en": "One kind consists of pronouns, such as 'He', 'I', and 'we'.",
      "disposition": "retain",
      "critical_note": "Context-specific speaker/person index is itself a modality of naming.",
      "source_siglum": "B2007",
      "source_url": "https://ablibrary.net/book_content/b/9606/46?lang=ar",
