.fr-results{display:grid;gap:6px}
.fr-result{display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--line)!important;border-radius:9px;padding:11px 13px!important;color:var(--ink)!important;cursor:pointer}
.fr-result:hover,.fr-result:focus-visible{background:var(--accent-soft)}
.fr-result b{display:block;font:600 13px/1.5 ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink)}

.fr-pages{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(115px,1fr));gap:6px}

}

@media(prefers-contrast:more){.fr-dialog,.fr-result,.fr-dock,.reading-toolbar{border-width:2px}#document .b2007-page[data-part-start]::before{font-weight:800}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}.fr-progress-fill,.fr-toast{transition:none}}
@media print{
  html,body{background:#fff!important;color:#000!important}
  #topbar,.heading .edition-status,.reading-toolbar,.fr-progress-track,.fr-dock,.fr-dialog,.fr-exit-focus,.fr-toast,.outline,.scholarly-apparatus,.article-foot{display:none!important}
  .heading{padding:0 0 14px;max-width:none}
  .heading h1{font-size:21pt}.heading .ar-title{font-size:20pt}
  #document{padding:0;max-width:none;font-size:11.5pt;line-height:1.55}
  #document .b2007-page p{line-height:1.57!important;margin:0 0 .7em!important}
  body.reader-clean #document .b2007-page h3{position:static!important;clip-path:none!important;width:auto!important;height:auto!important;white-space:normal!important;overflow:visible!important;font:600 9pt ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif!important;color:#555;margin:6pt 0!important}
  #document .b2007-page[data-part-start]::before{color:#333;break-after:avoid}
  #document .b2007-page{break-inside:auto}
}

### `critical-edition.html`

<!-- BEGIN GNAMMA SOURCE critical-edition.html SHA b24cf6557523f1a07ae1f9aa64c55838ea3e8a63 UTF8_BYTES 18336 -->
<!doctype html><html lang="en" data-theme="parchment">
<head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="description" content="GNAMMA source-checked clause-by-clause Farghānī introduction, all 128 Beirut introductory printed-page labels, with evidence grades, with Arabic original, new English review, critical flags and witness register. Not a definitive manuscript edition.">
<title>Farghānī · Critical clause review · GNAMMA</title>
<link rel="icon" href="../../../assets/gnamma-mark.svg" type="image/svg+xml">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="../../al-turka/qawaid-al-tawhid/reader.css">
<style>
:root{--reading-width:1130px}body{font-family:Georgia,"Iowan Old Style",serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink)}
header#topbar{position:sticky;top:0;min-height:53px;padding:7px clamp(12px,3vw,25px)}
#topbar .book-title{white-space:normal;line-height:1.3}
#topbar .right{gap:9px;font:600 12px/1.3 system-ui,sans-serif}
#topbar .right a{white-space:nowrap;text-decoration:none}
.page-wrap{max-width:1160px;padding:21px 19px 120px;margin:0 auto}
.page-head{max-width:970px;margin:0 auto 19px}
.page-head h1{font:500 clamp(28px,4vw,42px)/1.2 Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:-.025em;margin:8px 0}
.page-head p{font:14px/1.6 system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--muted);margin:8px 0}
.editorial-alert{background:var(--wash);border-left:3px solid var(--accent);padding:11px 14px;font:13px/1.55 system-ui,sans-serif;border-radius:4px;margin:13px 0}
.editorial-alert strong{color:var(--ink)}
.audit-status{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;margin:13px 0;color:var(--muted);font:12px/1.5 system-ui,sans-serif}
.audit-status strong{font-size:17px;color:var(--ink)}
.audit-tools{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:12px 0 18px;background:var(--float);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:8px;position:sticky;top:56px;z-index:15;backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}
.audit-tools label{font:600 11px system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--muted)}
.audit-tools select,.audit-tools input{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:7px;padding:8px 10px;background:var(--panel);color:var(--ink);font:12px/1.4 system-ui,sans-serif}
.audit-tools input[type=search]{flex:1 1 180px;min-width:120px}
.audit-tools select{max-width:170px}
.audit-tools button{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:7px;background:var(--panel);color:var(--accent);padding:8px 10px;font:600 12px system-ui,sans-serif}
.audit-tools button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--accent-soft);border-color:var(--accent)}
.source-section{margin:0 auto 16px;scroll-margin-top:120px}
.source-section h2{font:500 23px Georgia,serif;margin:22px 0 7px;padding-top:4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.source-section h2 small{display:inline;font:11px system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--muted)}
.audit-clause{padding:10px 0 11px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);scroll-margin-top:122px}
.audit-clause h3{margin:1px 0 7px;font:600 10px/1.55 system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.08em;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:9px;align-items:center;text-transform:uppercase}
.audit-clause h3 a{font-weight:500;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0}
.audit-flag{font:600 10px/1.5 system-ui,sans-serif;padding:2px 7px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:4px;color:var(--accent);background:var(--wash);text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0}
.audit-text{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(17px,3vw,38px)}
.audit-text .ar{font:23px/2 "Amiri","Noto Naskh Arabic","Traditional Arabic",serif;direction:rtl;text-align:right;unicode-bidi:plaintext;margin:0}
.audit-text .en{font:17px/1.78 Georgia,serif;margin:0}
.audit-note{margin:6px 0 0;font:12px/1.65 system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--muted);padding:8px 12px;border-left:2px solid var(--accent);background:var(--wash)}
.audit-note strong{color:var(--ink)}
.audit-clause[data-disposition=crux] .audit-flag{border-color:#bc945a}
.audit-witness{margin:8px 0;padding:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:7px;background:var(--panel);font:12px/1.6 system-ui,sans-serif}.audit-witness p.ar{font:21px/1.8 "Amiri","Noto Naskh Arabic",serif;margin:4px 0}.audit-witness p{margin:4px 0}.audit-witness a{color:var(--accent)}
.data-note{font:12px/1.6 system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--muted);margin-top:12px}
[data-show-notes=false] .audit-note{display:none}
[data-language=ar] .audit-text,[data-language=en] .audit-text{grid-template-columns:1fr}
[data-language=ar] .audit-text .en,[data-language=en] .audit-text .ar{display:none}
#empty{display:none;font:14px system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--muted);padding:25px}
footer{font:12px/1.7 system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--muted);border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:12px;margin-top:30px}
@media(max-width:760px){
#topbar{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.book-title{display:none}
.page-wrap{padding:15px 13px 90px}
.audit-tools{gap:6px;top:50px;padding:6px}
.audit-text{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:5px}
.audit-text .ar{font-size:23px;line-height:1.84}
.audit-text .en{font-size:17px;line-height:1.65}
.audit-clause{padding:7px 0 8px}
.audit-clause h3{margin:0 0 4px}
}
@media print{header#topbar,.audit-tools{display:none}.audit-clause{break-inside:avoid}.source-section h2{break-after:avoid}.page-wrap{max-width:none}}

.editorial-alert{background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:9px 13px;margin:12px 0;color:var(--muted)}
.editorial-alert summary{font:600 12px/1.6 ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;color:var(--accent)}
.editorial-alert p{margin:8px 0;font-size:12px}
.audit-witness{padding:9px 12px;margin:8px 0;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);border-radius:9px}
.audit-witness summary{font:600 12px/1.5 ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--accent);cursor:pointer}
.audit-witness[open]{border-color:var(--accent)}
.visible-results{color:var(--muted);font:12px/1.5 ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;margin:7px 0}
.audit-pagination{display:flex;justify-content:center;margin:22px 0 35px}
.audit-pagination button{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);color:var(--accent);border-radius:10px;padding:11px 20px;font:600 13px ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif}
.audit-pagination button[hidden]{display:none}
footer details{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;padding:12px 15px}
footer summary{font:600 12px/1.6 ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;color:var(--accent)}
footer p{line-height:1.9}
@media(max-width:760px){.audit-tools{top:55px}.page-head{margin-bottom:11px}.audit-witness p.ar{font-size:21px}}

.audit-status{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));align-items:start;gap:12px;margin:12px 0;color:var(--muted)}
.audit-status span{min-width:0;font:11px/1.55 ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif}
.audit-status strong{display:block;font:500 22px/1.1 Georgia,serif;margin-bottom:2px;color:var(--ink)}
@media(max-width:760px){.audit-status{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:13px 15px;margin:11px 0 15px}.audit-status strong{font-size:21px}.page-head p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}}

<details class="editorial-alert"><summary>Source grades and critical limitations</summary><p><strong>Critical status:</strong> 283 selected checks against the B2007 digitized edited Arabic, 276 checks against a later <strong>derivative online retranscription</strong> of that edition, plus fifteen photographed 1876 print-to-modern-digital bounded phrase checks, including corrections to p48 بسبحات and p52 اسم الحكم. The derivative source is <strong>not</strong> an independent witness. <strong>Zero</strong> manuscript collations. ### `critical-reader.js`

<!-- BEGIN GNAMMA SOURCE critical-reader.js SHA 3ba13c7643f659b771a73b6480a6b0553e4e9c95 UTF8_BYTES 6796 -->
/* GNAMMA critical clause viewer — local data only, no network.
 * Source grades distinguish modern Beirut text, photographed 1876 print, and still-unexamined manuscripts.
 */
(() => {
"use strict";
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
const sources=[window.FARGHANI_CRITICAL_PASS_001,window.FARGHANI_CRITICAL_PASS_002,window.FARGHANI_CRITICAL_PASS_003,window.FARGHANI_CRITICAL_PASS_004,window.FARGHANI_CRITICAL_PASS_005,window.FARGHANI_CRITICAL_PASS_006,window.FARGHANI_CRITICAL_PASS_007,window.FARGHANI_CRITICAL_PASS_008,window.FARGHANI_CRITICAL_PASS_009,window.FARGHANI_CRITICAL_PASS_010,window.FARGHANI_CRITICAL_PASS_011].filter(Boolean);
const rows=sources.flatMap(s=>s.records||[]).sort((a,b)=>a.page-b.page || a.id.localeCompare(b.id));
let lang="both",notes=false,limit=60;
const pageParam=Number(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("page"));
if(Number.isInteger(pageParam)&&pageParam>=18&&pageParam<=145) $("page-select").value=String(pageParam);
function el(tag,className,text) {
 const n=document.createElement(tag);if(className)n.className=className;if(text!==undefined)n.textContent=text;return n;
}
function open(source){const secondary=String(source.source_grade||"").startsWith("secondary-");const title=secondary?"Derivative Arabic transcription · B2007 p.":"Digitized modern Arabic · B2007 p.";const a=el("a",null,title+source.page);a.href=source.source_url;a.target="_blank";a.rel="noopener noreferrer";return a;}
function clause(x){
const item=el("article","audit-clause");item.id=x.id;item.dataset.disposition=x.disposition;
const meta=el("h3");meta.append(el("span",null,x.id),el("span","audit-flag",x.disposition==="crux"?"Needs witness":x.disposition==="corrected"?"Recorded correction":x.disposition==="revise"?"Translation revised":x.disposition==="annotate"?"Source note":"Checked source"));meta.append(open(x));if(String(x.source_grade||"").startsWith("secondary-"))meta.append(el("span","audit-flag","Derivative source: not independent witness"));item.append(meta);
const pair=el("div","audit-text"),ar=el("p","ar",x.ar),en=el("p","en",x.en);ar.lang="ar";ar.dir="rtl";pair.append(ar,en);item.append(pair);
if(x.historical_print){const w=x.historical_print;const hist=el("details","audit-witness");hist.append(el("summary",null,"Historical print I1876 p."+w.printed_page+" · scan "+w.scan_index+" · "+(w.status==="historical-print-difference"?"Different reading":"Agreement")));const ar=el("p","ar",w.reading);ar.lang="ar";ar.dir="rtl";hist.append(ar,el("p",null,w.note));const link=el("a",null,"Original facsimile PDF");link.href=w.source_pdf;link.target="_blank";link.rel="noopener noreferrer";hist.append(link);if(x.edited_ar && x.edited_ar!==x.ar){const lab=el("p","audit-edited-label","Provisional edited Arabic:");lab.style.fontSize="11px";lab.style.fontWeight="600";const corrected=el("p","ar",x.edited_ar);corrected.lang="ar";corrected.dir="rtl";hist.append(lab,corrected);}
const found=String(w.scan_index||"").match(/[0-9]+/g)||[];
for(const scan of found){const photo=el("a",null," · Inspect photographed scan "+scan);photo.href=(w.original_image_url || ((w.hires?"facsimile-I1876-hires":"facsimile-I1876")+"/images/scan_"+String(scan).padStart(4,"0")+".jpg"));photo.target="_blank";photo.rel="noopener noreferrer";hist.append(photo);}
if(found.length){const d=el("details","audit-photo-details"),summ=el("summary",null,"Show the photographed historical printing");d.append(summ);for(const scan of found){const a=el("a");a.href=(w.original_image_url || ((w.hires?"facsimile-I1876-hires":"facsimile-I1876")+"/images/scan_"+String(scan).padStart(4,"0")+".jpg"));a.target="_blank";a.rel="noopener noreferrer";const img=el("img");img.src=a.href;img.loading="lazy";img.decoding="async";img.alt="I1876 historical printing, PDF scan "+scan;img.style.cssText="display:block;width:100%;max-width:550px;height:auto;margin:8px auto";a.append(img);d.append(a);}hist.append(d);}item.append(hist);}
const note=el("aside","audit-note");note.append(el("strong",null,"Editorial decision: "),document.createTextNode(x.critical_note));item.append(note);
return item;
}
function render(){
const page=$("page-select").value,disp=$("filter-select").value,q=$("query").value.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
const filtered=rows.filter(x=>(page==="all"||String(x.page)===page)&&(disp==="all"||x.disposition===disp||disp==="revise"&&x.disposition==="corrected"||disp==="print"&&!!x.historical_print||disp==="derivative"&&String(x.source_grade||"").startsWith("secondary-"))&&(!q||[x.ar,x.en,x.critical_note,x.id].some(v=>v.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(q))));
const list=$("clauses");list.replaceChildren();let last=null;let group=null;
for(const x of filtered.slice(0,limit)){if(last!==x.page){group=el("section","source-section");group.id="p"+x.page;const title=el("h2",null,"Beirut printed page "+x.page);title.append(el("small",null,x.page>=61?" · selected passages from derivative retranscription (not an independent printed witness)":" · selected passages compared to edited digital Arabic (not full-page proof)"));group.append(title);list.append(group);last=x.page;}group.append(clause(x))}
$("empty").style.display=filtered.length?"none":"block";
$("visible-results").textContent=filtered.length ? "Showing "+Math.min(filtered.length,limit)+" of "+filtered.length+" matching passages" : "No matching passages";
const more=$("load-more");more.hidden=filtered.length<=limit;
more.textContent="Show next "+Math.min(60,Math.max(0,filtered.length-limit))+" passages";
document.body.dataset.language=lang;document.body.dataset.showNotes=String(notes);
$("count").textContent=String(rows.length);$("pages").textContent=String([...new Set(rows.map(x=>x.page))].length);$("cruces").textContent=String(rows.filter(x=>x.disposition==="crux").length);
$("notes-button").setAttribute("aria-pressed",String(notes));$("lang-button").textContent=({both:"AR + EN",ar:"Arabic only",en:"English only"})[lang];
}
const reset=()=>{limit=60;render();};
$("page-select").addEventListener("change",reset);$("filter-select").addEventListener("change",reset);$("query").addEventListener("input",reset);
$("load-more").addEventListener("click",()=>{limit+=60;render();});
let printLimit=null;
addEventListener("beforeprint",()=>{printLimit=limit;limit=Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;render();});
addEventListener("afterprint",()=>{if(printLimit!==null){limit=printLimit;printLimit=null;render();}});
$("lang-button").addEventListener("click",()=>{lang=lang==="both"?"ar":lang==="ar"?"en":"both";render()});
$("notes-button").addEventListener("click",()=>{notes=!notes;render()});
render();
if(location.hash){const match=rows.find(x=>"#"+x.id===location.hash);if(match){$("page-select").value=String(match.page);render();document.getElementById(match.id)?.scrollIntoView({block:"start"});}}
})();

<!-- BEGIN GNAMMA SOURCE reader.js SHA c624e9303ce781f2548d0d4d9962891ec7c0d7e6 UTF8_BYTES 13973 -->
/* GNAMMA Farghānī — deliberately small, source-based reader.
 * No automatic text is manufactured. Only the 32 curated Arabic–English source extracts are displayed.
 */
(() => {
  "use strict";
  const units = Array.isArray(window.FARGHANI_UNITS) ? window.FARGHANI_UNITS : [];
  const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
  const body = document.body;
  const root = document.documentElement;
  const storeKey = "gnamma-farghani-muntaha-v1";
  let current = Math.max(0, units.findIndex(u => "#" + u.id === location.hash));
  let bookmarks = [];
  let saved = {};
  try {
    saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(storeKey) || "{}") || {};
    bookmarks = Array.isArray(saved.bookmarks) ? saved.bookmarks.filter(x=>units.some(u=>u.id===x)) : [];
  } catch (_) { saved = {}; }
  const preferences = {
    language: ["ar","en","both"].includes(saved.language) ? saved.language : "both",
    notes: saved.notes === true,
    compare: saved.compare === true,
    continuous: saved.continuous === true,
    theme: ["parchment","horizon","night"].includes(saved.theme) ? saved.theme : "parchment",
    focus: 0,
    scale: Number(saved.scale) >= .8 && Number(saved.scale) <= 1.5 ? Number(saved.scale) : 1
  };
  function persist() {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(storeKey, JSON.stringify({
        bookmarks, language:preferences.language, notes:preferences.notes,
        compare:preferences.compare, continuous:preferences.continuous,
        theme:preferences.theme, scale:preferences.scale
      }));
    } catch (_) { /* Storage may be blocked in private mode. */ }
  }
  const el = (tag, cls, text) => {
    const e = document.createElement(tag);
    if (cls) e.className = cls;
    if (text !== undefined) e.textContent = text;
    return e;
  };
  function link(text,href,cls) {
    const a = el("a",cls,text);
    a.href=href;
    if (/^https?:/.test(href)) { a.target="_blank"; a.rel="noopener noreferrer"; }
    return a;
  }
  function apply() {
    root.dataset.theme=preferences.theme;
    root.style.setProperty("--scale", String(preferences.scale));
    body.dataset.language=preferences.language;
    body.dataset.showNotes=String(preferences.notes);
    body.dataset.compare=String(preferences.compare);
    body.dataset.continuous=String(preferences.continuous);
    body.dataset.focus=String(preferences.focus);
    $("lang-ar").setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(preferences.language !== "en"));
    $("lang-en").setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(preferences.language !== "ar"));
    $("notes-button").setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(preferences.notes));
    $("compare-button").setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(preferences.compare));
    $("continuous-button").setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(preferences.continuous));
    $("continuous-button").textContent=preferences.continuous ? "One extract" : "All 32 extracts";
    $("focus-button").textContent=["Focus: normal","Focus: reading","Focus: deep"][preferences.focus];
  }
  function makeUnit(u) {
    const article=el("article","reading-block");
    article.id=u.id;
    const meta=el("div","section-meta");
    meta.append(el("span","small-pill",u.id),el("span",null,"Foundation I · p. "+u.page),el("span",null,u.topic));
    meta.append(link("Arabic source ↗",u.sourceUrl,"source-link"));
    article.append(meta,el("h3",null,u.title));
    const pair=el("div","text-pair");
    const ar=el("div","ar");
    ar.lang="ar"; ar.dir="rtl";
    const arLabel=el("span","text-label","Arabic · authorial extract");
    const arText=el("p",null,u.ar);
    arText.lang="ar"; arText.dir="rtl";
    ar.append(arLabel,arText);
    const en=el("div","en");
    en.lang="en";
    en.append(el("span","text-label","English · new working translation"),el("p",null,u.en));
    pair.append(ar,en);
    article.append(pair);
    article.append(el("p","extract-disclaimer","Selected matching clause, not a complete printed-page translation. Open the linked source for surrounding text."));
    const note=el("aside","research-note");
    note.append(el("strong",null,"Textual / conceptual note"),el("div",null,u.note));
    article.append(note);
    const comp=el("aside","comparison-note");
    comp.append(el("strong",null,"Comparative research question — not Farghānī’s text"),el("div",null,u.compare));
    article.append(comp);
    return article;
  }
  function setCurrent(index, scroll=true) {
    current=Math.min(Math.max(index,0),units.length-1);
    const u=units[current]; if(!u)return;
    if(location.hash!=="#"+u.id) history.replaceState(null,"","#"+u.id);
    render();
    if(scroll) $("reading").scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth",block:"start"});
  }
  function render() {
    apply();
    const list=$("reading-list");
    list.replaceChildren();
    if(!units.length) {
      list.append(el("p","untranslated","Source corpus is unavailable. Consult editorial/STATUS.md and the printed Arabic source."));
      return;
    }
    if(preferences.continuous) {
      const frag=document.createDocumentFragment();
      units.forEach(u=>frag.append(makeUnit(u)));
      list.append(frag);
    } else {
      list.append(makeUnit(units[current]));
    }
    const u=units[current];
    $("current-heading").textContent=preferences.continuous ? "Continuous extracts · Foundation I" : u.title;
    $("source-status").textContent=preferences.continuous ? units.length+" separate excerpts, not continuous page coverage" : "Source page "+u.page+" · selected Arabic–English passage";
    $("location-title").textContent=preferences.continuous ? "All "+units.length+" extracts" : u.id+" · "+u.title;
    $("location-source").textContent=preferences.continuous ? "Arabic and English" : "Page "+u.page+" · "+u.topic;
    $("prev").disabled=preferences.continuous||current<=0;
    $("next").disabled=preferences.continuous||current>=units.length-1;
    $("prev-label").textContent=current>0?units[current-1].id:"—";
    $("next-label").textContent=current<units.length-1?units[current+1].id:"—";
    $("bookmark-button").textContent=bookmarks.includes(u.id)?"★ Saved":"☆ Save";
    $("reading-status").textContent=(current+1)+"/"+units.length+" curated bilingual extracts";
    persist();
  }
  function showToast(message) {
    const t=$("toast");
    t.textContent=message;
    t.classList.add("visible");
    clearTimeout(showToast.timer);
    showToast.timer=setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove("visible"),1800);
  }
  function choose(u) { closeSheet(); preferences.continuous=false;setCurrent(units.indexOf(u)); }
  function closeSheet() {
    const s=$("sheet");
    if(s.open) s.close();
  }
  function openSheet(mode) {
    const sheet=$("sheet");
    $("sheet-title").textContent=mode==="contents"?"Contents":mode==="search"?"Search":mode==="settings"?"Reading settings":"Comparative guide";
    const place=$("sheet-content");
    place.replaceChildren();
    if(mode==="contents" || mode==="search") {
      const input=el("input","sheet-input");
      input.type="search";input.placeholder="Find Arabic, English, title, or page…";
      input.setAttribute("aria-label","Search text");
      place.append(input);
      const results=el("div","sheet-list");
      place.append(results);
      const fill=()=>{
        const q=input.value.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
        results.replaceChildren();
        let shown=0;
        units.filter(u=>!q||[u.id,u.page,u.title,u.topic,u.ar,u.en,u.note].some(v=>String(v).toLocaleLowerCase().includes(q))).forEach(u=>{
          const row=el("div","sheet-result");
          const button=el("button",null,u.id+" · "+u.title);
          button.type="button";
          button.append(el("small",null,"p. "+u.page+" · "+u.topic+(bookmarks.includes(u.id)?" · ★ bookmarked":"")));
          if(u.id===units[current].id)button.classList.add("active");
          button.addEventListener("click",()=>choose(u));
          row.append(button);results.append(row);shown++;
        });
        if(!shown)results.append(el("p",null,"No matching selected extract. For the complete English introduction, use Full translation."));
      };
      input.addEventListener("input",fill);
      fill();
      sheet.showModal();
      if(mode==="search")input.focus();
      return;
    }
    if(mode==="settings") {
      const form=el("div");
      const addToggle=(text,key,fn)=>{
        const row=el("div","setting-row");
        const label=el("label");
        const cb=el("input");cb.type="checkbox";cb.checked=Boolean(preferences[key]);cb.addEventListener("change",()=>{preferences[key]=cb.checked;fn();render();});
        label.append(cb,document.createTextNode(" "+text));row.append(label);form.append(row);
      };
      addToggle("Show source and textual notes","notes",()=>{});
      addToggle("Show separate Guénon–Schuon comparisons","compare",()=>{});
      addToggle("Continuous scroll through all 32 selected extracts","continuous",()=>{});
      const scale=el("div","setting-row");
      scale.append(el("label",null,"Reading size "));
      const range=el("input");range.type="range";range.min=".8";range.max="1.5";range.step=".05";range.value=String(preferences.scale);
      range.addEventListener("input",()=>{preferences.scale=Number(range.value);apply();persist();});
      scale.append(range);form.append(scale);
      const status=el("div","setting-row");
      status.append(el("strong",null,"Source coverage"),el("p",null,"32 curated bilingual excerpts from the opening foundation, not the entire introduction. The English working draft covers all 128 introductory source-page labels; source and manuscript checking remains incomplete."));
      status.append(link("Detailed translation register","editorial/STATUS.md"));
      form.append(status);
      place.append(form);
    } else if(mode==="comparison") {
      const questions=[
        ["Beyond-Being and first determination","Do Farghānī's ranks correspond to Guénon's Beyond-Being and Being? The first determination is a barzakh of aḥadiyya and wāḥidiyya; it cannot simply be mapped by matching labels."],
        ["Absolute, Infinite, Perfect","Schuon's triad is comparable with Farghānī's essential and name-related perfections, but no source yet demonstrates their identity."],
        ["Unmanifestable possibility and fixed entities","The p. 23 concealed matters not yet determined at the second rank must be distinguished from intrinsically nonmanifestable possibilities."],
        ["Perfect Human and Muhammadan reality","Farghānī differentiates principial, cosmic, and Muhammadan comprehensiveness. An abstract 'Universal Man' may conceal the distinctions."],
        ["What is wujūd?","In p. 30–32, existence is linked to finding/presence at each rank; correspondence with Guénon's Existence has to be argued, not assumed."],
        ["Causation and created agency","Farghānī's 'giving by which realities find themselves' is not yet an articulated theory of intrinsic secondary causality."]
      ];
      place.append(el("p",null,"Research hypotheses, kept distinct from translated source."));
      for(const [title,desc] of questions){
        const details=el("details","setting-row");
        details.append(el("summary",null,title),el("p",null,desc));place.append(details);
      }
      place.append(link("Full comparative dossier","editorial/COMPARISON.md"));
    }
    sheet.showModal();
  }
  $("menu-button").addEventListener("click",()=>openSheet("contents"));
  $("location-button").addEventListener("click",()=>openSheet("contents"));
  $("search-button").addEventListener("click",()=>openSheet("search"));
  $("settings-button").addEventListener("click",()=>openSheet("settings"));
  $("sheet-close").addEventListener("click",closeSheet);
  $("prev").addEventListener("click",()=>setCurrent(current-1));
  $("next").addEventListener("click",()=>setCurrent(current+1));
  $("lang-ar").addEventListener("click",()=>{
    preferences.language=preferences.language==="both"?"en":"both";render();
  });
  $("lang-en").addEventListener("click",()=>{
    preferences.language=preferences.language==="both"?"ar":"both";render();
  });
  $("notes-button").addEventListener("click",()=>{preferences.notes=!preferences.notes;render();});
  $("compare-button").addEventListener("click",()=>{preferences.compare=!preferences.compare;render();});
  $("continuous-button").addEventListener("click",()=>{preferences.continuous=!preferences.continuous;render();});
  $("theme-button").addEventListener("click",()=>{
    const all=["parchment","horizon","night"];
    preferences.theme=all[(all.indexOf(preferences.theme)+1)%all.length];render();
  });
  $("focus-button").addEventListener("click",()=>{preferences.focus=(preferences.focus+1)%3;apply();});
  $("focus-recover").addEventListener("click",()=>{preferences.focus=0;apply();});
  $("bookmark-button").addEventListener("click",()=>{

    if(!id)return;

  $("read-all-button").addEventListener("click",()=>{preferences.continuous=true;render();$("reading").scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth"});});

  window.addEventListener("hashchange",()=>{
    const index=units.findIndex(u=>location.hash==="#"+u.id);

  });

    if($("sheet").open||e.target.matches("input,textarea,select"))return;

  });
  render();

### `reader.css`

<!-- BEGIN GNAMMA SOURCE reader.css SHA 698db6585024300a4bcbae7d35bdf498c4c2ee96 UTF8_BYTES 6433 -->
/* Farghānī reader: GNAMMA/Darūrī-family shell + disciplined textual apparatus. */
:root{--reading-width:1050px}
#topbar .icon-btn{font:500 24px/1 ui-sans-serif,system-ui;color:var(--ink)}
#topbar .brand-link strong{font-size:11px}
#focus-recover{font-size:24px}
#controlbar .seg button{padding:7px 10px}
.reading-context,.editorial-links{max-width:1040px;margin:0 auto;padding:10px 24px 25px}
.reading-context details{background:var(--wash);padding:10px 17px;border-radius:10px;color:var(--muted);font:13px/1.7 system-ui,sans-serif}
.reading-context summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:650;color:var(--ink)}
.reading-context ol{padding-left:24px}
.reading-context li{margin:6px 0}
.reading-context p{margin:8px 0}
#reading-list{min-height:260px}
.reading-block{padding:22px 0 30px}
.reading-block:first-child{padding-top:18px}
.reading-block h3{margin:6px 0 18px;font-size:clamp(22px,3vw,28px);font-weight:500}
.reading-block .section-meta{justify-content:flex-start;gap:8px}
.section-meta .source-link{color:var(--accent);font:600 11px system-ui,sans-serif}
.text-pair{column-gap:clamp(18px,3vw,52px)}
.text-pair .ar{font-size:calc(25px * var(--scale));line-height:2.12;white-space:pre-line}
.text-pair .en{font-size:calc(19px * var(--scale));line-height:1.85;white-space:pre-line}
.text-pair .text-label{white-space:nowrap}
.extract-disclaimer{font:11px/1.5 system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--muted);margin:12px 0 0}
.research-note,.comparison-note{font:13px/1.7 system-ui,sans-serif;padding:13px 16px;border-left:2px solid var(--accent);margin:17px 0 0;background:var(--wash);color:var(--muted)}
.research-note strong,.comparison-note strong{color:var(--ink);font-size:12px}
.comparison-note{background:var(--accent-soft)}
body[data-show-notes="false"] .research-note{display:none}
body[data-compare="false"] .comparison-note{display:none}
body[data-continuous="true"] .reading-block{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
body[data-continuous="true"] .reading-block + .reading-block{padding-top:28px}
body[data-continuous="true"] .reading-block h3{font-size:23px}
body[data-continuous="true"] #reading-dock{grid-template-columns:1fr}
body[data-continuous="true"] #reading-dock .dock-btn{display:none}
#reading-dock .dock-center{cursor:pointer}
.editorial-links{font:13px/1.8 system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--muted);border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-bottom:125px}
.editorial-links h2{font:500 26px Georgia,serif;color:var(--ink)}
.editorial-links a{color:var(--accent)}
.site-footer{font:12px/1.8 system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--muted);padding:18px;text-align:center;margin-bottom:90px}
.site-footer a{color:var(--accent)}
#sheet-content .sheet-input{box-sizing:border-box}
.sheet-list button.active{background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent)}
.sheet-result{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:8px 0}
.sheet-result button{display:block;width:100%;padding:10px;border:0;border-radius:8px;text-align:left;color:var(--ink);background:transparent;cursor:pointer;font:14px/1.5 system-ui,sans-serif}
.sheet-result button:hover,.sheet-result button:focus-visible{background:var(--accent-soft)}
.sheet-result small{display:block;color:var(--muted)}
.sheet-input{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);padding:11px;font:14px system-ui,sans-serif}
.setting-row{padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font:13px/1.6 system-ui,sans-serif}
.setting-row input{accent-color:var(--accent)}
.setting-row label{cursor:pointer}
.setting-row p{color:var(--muted)}
#toast{position:fixed;z-index:80;bottom:105px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);padding:9px 15px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);font:12px system-ui,sans-serif;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
#toast.visible{opacity:1}
body[data-focus="1"] .book-intro,body[data-focus="1"] .reading-context,body[data-focus="2"] .book-intro,body[data-focus="2"] .reading-context{display:none}
body[data-focus="2"] #topbar,body[data-focus="2"] #controlbar{display:none}
body[data-focus="2"] #focus-recover{display:inline-flex}
body[data-focus="2"] .reader-stage{padding-top:34px}
body[data-focus="2"] .stage-header{padding-top:9px}
@media(max-width:760px){
  .book-title{max-width:41vw}
  .book-title small{display:none}
  #controlbar{gap:5px;padding:7px}
  #controlbar .seg button{min-height:32px;padding:5px 8px}
  .reader-status{display:none}
  .reader-stage{padding:10px 15px 125px}
  .book-intro{padding:26px 18px 18px}
  .reading-context,.editorial-links{padding-left:17px;padding-right:17px}
  .text-pair{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:15px}
  .text-pair .ar{font-size:calc(24px * var(--scale));line-height:2.05}
  .text-pair .en{font-size:calc(18px * var(--scale))}
  .reading-block h3{font-size:22px}
  .stage-header h2{font-size:25px}
  .section-meta{gap:5px}
  .stage-source{white-space:normal}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}}

/* Compact continuous-mode inter-unit rhythm; retains readable lines and section boundaries. */
body[data-continuous="true"] .reading-block{padding:6px 0 10px!important;margin:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
body[data-continuous="true"] .reading-block+.reading-block{padding-top:8px!important}
body[data-continuous="true"] .reading-block h3{margin:3px 0 6px!important;font-size:19px;line-height:1.3}
body[data-continuous="true"] .reading-block .text-pair{gap:clamp(10px,2vw,25px)}
body[data-continuous="true"] .reading-block .text-pair p{margin:3px 0 5px;line-height:1.73}
body[data-continuous="true"] .research-note,body[data-continuous="true"] .comparison-note{margin:6px 0 3px;padding:7px 10px}
body[data-continuous="true"] .extract-disclaimer{margin:5px 0 0}
@media(max-width:760px){body[data-continuous="true"] .reading-block{padding:4px 0 7px!important}body[data-continuous="true"] .reading-block+.reading-block{padding-top:6px!important}body[data-continuous="true"] .reading-block h3{font-size:18px}}

/* Stage XVIII: scholarly bibliography is available on demand, never interleaved with reading. */
.editorial-links{padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.editorial-links details{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:13px 17px}
.editorial-links summary{cursor:pointer;color:var(--accent);font:600 13px/1.55 ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif}
.editorial-links h2{font-size:20px;margin:15px 0 8px}
@media(max-width:760px){.editorial-links{padding-top:13px}}

<!-- END GNAMMA SOURCE reader.css -->

<!-- BEGIN GNAMMA SOURCE index.html SHA 63d9a76c490b3cd6276a2630ba1357533689ed24 UTF8_BYTES 12021 -->
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en" data-theme="parchment">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#fbf9f4">
<meta name="description" content="Farghānī introduction: 128-page working English introduction; 283 modern B2007 Arabic checked excerpts plus 276 lower-grade derivative Arabic excerpts, all printed page labels 18–145 represented; fifteen bounded historic-print checks; manuscript-critical verification ongoing.">
<title>Muntahā al-madārik · Farghānī · GNAMMA</title>
<link rel="icon" href="../../../assets/gnamma-mark.svg" type="image/svg+xml">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="../../al-turka/qawaid-al-tawhid/reader.css">

    <p class="lede">Saʿīd al-Dīn al-Farghānī’s systematic introduction to the <em>Tāʾiyya</em> commentary. The four foundations and concluding preface have a complete <strong>English working draft (Beirut pp.18–145)</strong>. Begin with the uninterrupted text; consult bilingual checks and source-critical notes separately.</p>

    <details class="edition-scope"><summary>Editorial status · source grades and limits</summary><p class="help-copy"><strong>Edition status:</strong> English translation of the introduction is complete in page coverage, but <em>not definitive</em>. The bilingual selected-excerpt register contains 283 B2007-digitized checks (pp.18–60) and 276 derivative-forum checks (pp.61–145); *direct 1876 photographic comparison* documents seven differences against modern digitized readings (including p48 بسبحات vs بسبحاب and p52 اسم الحكم vs سم الحكيم) and eight bounded agreements. Fifteen selected loci occur across fourteen distinct 1876 printed pages (no full page proof); manuscript folios and comprehensive line-by-line proofing remain open. The 32 existing bilingual source extracts remain selected excerpts, not full parallel Arabic. Compact continuous reading mode is retained.</p></details>

  {

    "page": 30,
    "title": "Essential perfection versus perfection through the names",
    "topic": "Perfection",
    "ar": "وأمّا القسم الثاني من الكمال، فهو الكمال الأسمائي المفصّل الساري في تفاصيل الأسماء والحقائق",
    "en": "The second kind of perfection is the differentiated perfection through the divine names, extending throughout the particulars of the names and realities.",
    "note": "He contrasts this with essential perfection, which is realized without any condition; name-related perfection requires determination, loci, relative otherness and manifestation.",
    "compare": "Compare Schuon's Absolute–Infinite–Perfect triad, but do not treat 'essential perfection' as a literal translation of Schuon's 'Perfect'.",

    "id": "F020",
    "page": 30,
    "title": "Definitions of knowledge, existence, light, and witnessing",
    "topic": "Existence",
    "ar": "واعتبار الوجود الذي حقيقته ما به وجدان العين نفسه في نفسه أو في غيره، أو غيره في غيره من محل ومرتبة ونحوهما",
    "en": "And the consideration of existence, whose reality is that whereby a reality finds itself in itself or in another—or finds another in another, such as in a locus, a rank, or something similar.",
    "note": "Wujūd here is tied lexically to wijdān ('finding'). The nearby definitions specify knowledge as a reality's appearing to a reality, light as what discloses the hidden, and witnessing as presence with what is witnessed.",
    "compare": "This is a vital terminological problem for aligning Farghānī's wujūd with Guénon's Being and universal Existence.",

    "scope": "exact selected source clause, not entire printed page"

    "title": "Knowledge in the first rank",
    "topic": "Existence",

    "en": "Knowledge at the first rank and first determination is the reality of the Essence appearing to itself while the considerations of oneness are included within it and established; consequently it has one known object.",
    "note": "The following grammatical observation is precise: in this rank the verb 'to know' is taken with one object; at the second rank, in the relevant construction, divine knowledge concerns the Essence as possessing differentiated perfections.",

    "topic": "Existence",
    "ar": "أن الوجود من حيث المرتبة الأولى ما به وجدان الذات نفسها في نفسها باندراج اعتبارات الواحدية فيها وجدان مجمل مندرج فيه تفصيله محكوم عليه بنفي الكثرة والمغايرة والغيرية والتميّز",

    "topic": "Names",
    "ar": "فله حينئذ وحدة حقيقية وكثرة نسبية، فإن كل اسم إلهيّ إنما هو ظاهر الوجود الذي هو عين الذات، لكن من تعيّنه وتقيّده لمعنى أو قل بصفة كالحيّ مثلا",

    "en": "Existence, then, means and is in reality that by which the form of each determination finds itself and what is like itself as a spiritual, imaginal, or corporeal existent, appearing in each rank according to its own character and rule.",

    "topic": "Existence",
    "ar": "فالإيجاد والخلق على هذا ما هو إلّا إعطاء الموجد الخالق تعالى وتقدّس للحقائق الكونيّة ما به وجدانها بإضافة تعيّن منه إليها",
    "en": "On this account, bringing into existence and creating is nothing other than the Creator's—exalted and holy is He—giving cosmic realities that through which they find themselves, by attributing to them a determination from Him.",

    "scope": "exact selected source clause, not entire printed page"

    "en": "These are privative matters and relations: they possess no existence externally or in themselves.
